[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Cross-Functional Collaboration and Alignment in Technical Teams"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"In modern software engineering, delivering complex products requires seamless collaboration between engineering, product management, design, and quality assurance. Cross-functional alignment ensures that all teams work toward shared business goals without communication silos."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"Core Principles of Alignment"},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Shared Objectives: Establish clear OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) that span across departments."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Transparent Documentation: Maintain a single source of truth for architectural decisions and product specs."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Regular Syncs: Implement targeted cross-functional meetings rather than status updates."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Implementing a Shared Architecture Decision Record (ADR)"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"To align technical and product teams, use an ADR template to document choices clearly. This prevents misunderstandings about why certain frameworks or APIs were chosen."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"# ADR 001: Adopt GraphQL for Client-Server Communication

## Status
Accepted

## Context
Our mobile and web clients require different data payloads, leading to over-fetching with our current REST endpoints.

## Decision
We will migrate our primary public API to GraphQL to allow clients to request exact data structures."},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Measuring Success"},{"order":12,"type":"paragraph","text":"Track metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time for changes, and cross-team dependency delays. High alignment directly correlates with reduced rework and faster time-to-market."}]
